item.description: History made! Marc Marquez secures 8th MotoGP World Championship on momentous day in Portugal! 🏆 A crowning achievement, celebrated with his only fellow 8-times MotoGP champion! Watch the moment Marc wrapped it up… motogp.io/MMarquezWorldChampion26 🎙️ The first words from the 2026 champ! Watch the emotional interview with Marc Marquez… motogp.io/MMarquezFirstWords 🥇 The numbers only tell part of the story! Take a deep dive into the statistics behind Marc’s latest success… motogp.io/MartinSaturdayPOR 🇵🇹 Repsol Grand Prix of Portugal – Winners MotoGP ™ – M Bezzecchi 🇮🇹 (Aprilia Racing) Marc Marquez – 2026 MotoGP World Champion Moto2 ™ – D Muñoz 🇪🇸 (Italtrans Racing Team) Moto3 ™ – M Quiles 🇪🇸 (CFMOTO Gaviota Aspar Team)

item.description: Not over yet! Bezzecchi finally ends Sprint drought as mind-blowing Marquez error keeps the title race alive! 😲 A lap and a half from the title, before the unthinkable happened! Marc Marquez explains his late slip-up… https://motogp.io/MMarquezSaturdayPOR 🥇 One miracle down, three to go!
